summary.text: Allen Blackmon is a Republican who represents Senate District 27 (Chesterfield, Kershaw and Lancaster Counties) in the South Carolina Senate; he lives in Lancaster County and serves on the Banking and Insurance, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary, Rules and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: Blackmon was born August 6, 1955, at Langley Air Force Base and graduated from Clemson University with a B.S. in 1978.
He is listed as retired and has been a licensed general contractor since 2016, and he served as a substitute teacher in the Lancaster County School District in 2017-18.

His local service listed on the page includes the Lancaster County Joint Planning Commission from 1989 to 2002 (chairman 1999-2002), the board of Arrowpointe Federal Credit Union from 2005 to 2021, and chairman of the Lancaster County Republican Party in 2016.
He served on Lancaster County Council from 2019 to 2024 and has been on the board of Founders Federal Credit Union since 2022.
